key_insight: O-kRystal learns momentum- and spin-resolved corrections from low-cost PBE orbitals to predict near-HSE06 electronic band structures beyond standard DFT.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster, more accurate band-structure screening for materials design, including systems with complex magnetism, strong correlation, and low-dimensional electronic behavior.
method: Use PBE as a baseline energy source and orbital descriptor provider.
Combine real-space and reciprocal-space orbital matrices to learn state-wise corrections.
Predict higher-level energies across crystal momentum and spin, then reconstruct DOS from dense k-point predictions.
evidence_signal: Across nearly 6,000 3D materials, the model achieves 0.171 ± 0.009 eV MAE for states within 5 eV of the band-edge midpoint, and it also improves strongly correlated materials and transfers to G0W0 on 2D systems.
watch_item: Accuracy is demonstrated for states near the band edge and on benchmarks; performance may be less reliable for far-from-edge states or materials outside the training distribution.
paper_title: Beyond DFT electronic band structures via dual-space orbital learning
